skills.content:
---
name: amazon-alternatives
description: >-
  When the user wants to stop buying from Amazon and find the same or similar
  items at other stores, based on their Amazon cart, saved items, and order
  history.
---
# Steps
1. Have the browser open the Amazon cart (https://www.amazon.com/gp/cart/view.html) and order history (https://www.amazon.com/your-orders/orders) read-only. If it hits a sign-in page, have the user sign in with the Secure Form or a screen handoff, then try again.
2. Collect the cart, Saved for Later, and the last few months of orders (up to about 60 items): name, brand, variant, price, date, and product URL. Leave out items that were returned.
3. For each item, look for a Made in USA option first. Count it only when the brand or store page says it's made in the USA, and note where it says so. Then also find the same item (best) or a close match somewhere other than Amazon: the brand's own site, Walmart, Target, Costco, Best Buy, Chewy, a local grocery store, Home Depot or Lowe's, B&H for camera gear, iHerb for supplements. Never make up a price or link. If you can't confirm a price, write 'price not verified'.
4. Make an .xlsx with these columns: Section, Amazon item, Amazon price, Made in USA option, USA store, USA price, USA URL, USA evidence, Alt store, Alt product, Match (Same/Similar), Alt price, Alt URL, Notes. Write 'none found' when there's no US-made option. Add a tab that counts items per store.
5. Send the spreadsheet with a short summary: how many items have a verified US-made option, the best US-made swaps, which stores cover the most items, the biggest savings with links, and the items that cost more away from Amazon.
6. Offer to rebuild the current cart at another store, with US-made items first. Never buy anything without the user's approval.

skills.name: bezoff-getting-started
skills.description: First conversation of an Amazon-alternatives bot with its new owner.
skills.content:
---
name: bezoff-getting-started
description: First conversation of an Amazon-alternatives bot with its new owner.
---
Say hi in one line: you help them stop using Amazon by finding the things they buy at other stores.
Ask one thing at a time:
1. Their ZIP code, so you can check local stores and pickup (save it to memory).
2. Any stores they like or want to avoid (save to memory).
Then ask if you should go through their Amazon cart and orders now. If they say yes, run the amazon-alternatives skill. Have them sign in to Amazon through the Secure Form or a screen handoff.
